mapper.select: select ct.id, ct.template_id as templateId, ct.company_dept_id as companyDeptId, ct.status, t.name as templateName, ct.calculation_cycle_start_date as cycleStart, ct.calculation_cycle_end_date as cycleEnd, ct.calculation_end_time as finishedAt from emission_calculation_template ct left join emission_template t on t.id=ct.template_id where ct.id=#{id}

select table_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = database() and column_name = 'energy_attribution_dept_id' and table_name in ('emission_fossil_fuel_meter_info', 'emission_meter_info', 'emission_purchased_heat_meter_info')
mapper.sql: case d.collection_point_type when -1 then null when 2 then fm.energy_attribution_dept_id when 1 then em.energy_attribution_dept_id when 3 then hm.energy_attribution_dept_id else null end
mapper.select: select d.id as id, cn.calculation_template_id as calculationTemplateId, d.emission_category as emissionCategory, d.emission_subcategory as emissionSubcategory, d.energy_measurement_value as energyMeasurementValue, d.adjusted_energy_value as adjustedEnergyValue, d.carbon_emission as carbonEmission, d.adjusted_carbon_emission as adjustedCarbonEmission, d.carbon_emission_factor as carbonEmissionFactor, d.carbon_emission_factor_unit as carbonEmissionFactorUnit, d.carbon_emission_unit as carbonEmissionUnit, d.data_status as dataStatus, d.data_missing_description as dataMissingDescription, nc.carbon_emission_factor as configuredFactor, nc.carbon_emission_factor_unit as configuredFactorUnit, df.factor_value as templateFactor, df.factor_unit as templateFactorUnit, d.measurement_unit as measurementUnit, d.collection_point_id as collectionPointId, d.collection_point_type as collectionPointType, coalesce(fm.energy_allocation, em.energy_allocation, hm.energy_allocation) as energyAllocation, coalesce(fm.name, em.name, hm.name) as facilityName, as attributionDeptId, (select case when company.status='0' and company.del_flag='0' then c.dept_id else null end from sys_dept md join sys_carbon_company c join sys_dept company on company.dept_id=c.dept_id where md.dept_id=() and md.status='0' and md.del_flag='0' and (c.dept_id=md.dept_id or find_in_set(c.dept_id, md.ancestors) > 0) order by (c.dept_id=md.dept_id) desc, find_in_set(c.dept_id, md.ancestors) desc, c.dept_id limit 1) as attributionCompanyDeptId from emission_collection_node_data d inner join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.id = d.calculation_node_id left join emission_node_config nc on nc.node_id = cn.node_id left join emission_calculation_template ct on ct.id = cn.calculation_template_id left join emission_template et on et.id = ct.template_id left join emission_default_factor df on df.id = ( select min(f.id) from emission_default_factor f where f.template_id = et.factor_template_id and f.status = 1 and (f.subcategory_name = d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci or f.subcategory_code = d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci) ) left join emission_fossil_fuel_meter_info fm on d.collection_point_type = 2 and fm.id = d.collection_point_id left join emission_meter_info em on d.collection_point_type = 1 and em.id = d.collection_point_id left join emission_purchased_heat_meter_info hm on d.collection_point_type = 3 and hm.id = d.collection_point_id where cn.calculation_template_id = #{calculationTemplateId} and cn.include_in_calculation = 1 and cn.excluded_by_node_id is null

select ct.id as calculationTemplateId, ct.template_id as emissionTemplateId, t.name as emissionTemplateName, t.factor_template_id as factorTemplateId, ft.template_name as factorTemplateName from emission_calculation_template ct left join emission_template t on t.id = ct.template_id left join emission_factor_template ft on ft.id = t.factor_template_id where ct.id = #{calculationTemplateId}

select id as id, template_id as templateId, subcategory_code as subcategoryCode, subcategory_name as subcategoryName, factor_source as factorSource, factor_id as factorId, factor_name as factorName, factor_value as factorValue, factor_unit as factorUnit, status as status from emission_default_factor where template_id = #{templateId} and (status is null or status = 1)

select id as id, fuel_type as fuelType, unit as unit, lower_heating_value as lowerHeatingValue, carbon_content_per_unit_heat as carbonContentPerUnitHeat, fuel_oxidation_rate as fuelOxidationRate, emission_factor as emissionFactor, factor_unit as factorUnit from emission_fossil_fuel_emission_factor where id = #{id}

select collection_point_type as collectionPointType, collection_point_id as collectionPointId, year as year, month as month, emission_category as emissionCategory, emission_subcategory as emissionSubcategory, measurement_unit as measurementUnit, energy_measurement_value as energyMeasurementValue, adjusted_energy_value as adjustedEnergyValue, carbon_emission as carbonEmission, adjusted_carbon_emission as adjustedCarbonEmission, data_status as dataStatus from emission_collection_node_data_month where year = #{year} and month >= #{startMonth} and month <= #{endMonth} and ( 1 = 0
or (collection_point_type = 1 and collection_point_id in #{id})
or (collection_point_type = 2 and collection_point_id in #{id})
or (collection_point_type = 3 and collection_point_id in #{id})
)

select collection_point_type as collectionPointType, collection_point_id as collectionPointId, year as year, month as month, emission_category as emissionCategory, emission_subcategory as emissionSubcategory, measurement_unit as measurementUnit, energy_measurement_value as energyMeasurementValue, adjusted_energy_value as adjustedEnergyValue, carbon_emission as carbonEmission, adjusted_carbon_emission as adjustedCarbonEmission, data_status as dataStatus from emission_collection_node_data_month where (year * 12 + month) between (#{startYear} * 12 + #{startMonth}) and (#{endYear} * 12 + #{endMonth}) and ( 1 = 0
or (collection_point_type = 1 and collection_point_id in #{id})
or (collection_point_type = 2 and collection_point_id in #{id})
or (collection_point_type = 3 and collection_point_id in #{id})
)
